home.title: YaldaTools — Free tools that run in your browser
home.description: Small, free tools with a retro look: QR codes, background removal and more. No sign-up, no ads, processed on your device.

qr.title: Free QR code generator: WiFi, URL, contact and WhatsApp — YaldaTools
qr.description: Create static QR codes that never expire for WiFi, links, contacts, WhatsApp and email. Colors, logo and PNG or SVG download, free and without sign-up.

removeBg.title: Remove image background for free, without uploading — YaldaTools
removeBg.description: Remove the background of your photos for free, in your browser: the image is never uploaded. Download a PNG with a transparent, white or colored background.

support.title: Support the project — YaldaTools
support.description: YaldaTools is free and ad-free. Donations pay for the server and the time to build more tools.
